items.description: Segment is the web application that lets users collect, manage and route their customer analytics data. This mashup uses the Pipl API.
The Consolidated Screening List (CSL) is a list of parties for which the United States Government maintains restrictions on certain exports, re-exports or transfers of items.
lokerja.com is an Indonesian Job Listing aggregate. Using Indeed, this site pulls job listings sorted by location and reposts them on their own site.
Comprehensive map of UK schools with comparisons of student scores and search capabilities. Marker drill-down brings you to Dept of Education and Skills site details.

A way to share your pictures and files. Just tap and hold to push files between phones and tablets easily with no cables, no computer, no set up and no copy and paste. Currently for Android and Android Tablet.

WhtvrMe is an iOS and Android app that is a simple way for two people to make a plan. Once one person has the app, they can send a Whtvr to another person, who is sent an SMS prompting them to install the app. Once they have it installed, the app lets two people plan a date, and gives them timely and relevant suggestions on things to do in their area.
One stop shop to view media and know everything about any music artist on one page. Combines YouTube, Last.fm, Google Maps and Amazon shopping APIs.
hasLockers is a cloud service for content locking based on hasOffers API.
Compare LCD TV prices. The product and price data feed is pulled from the Shopping.com API.
Create a custom monster, then have it printed on t-shirts, mugs, bags, and more fun Zazzle products.
BART station maps, schedules, timetables, and other details in a convenient Google Map
Search for a rest area anywhere in the US. Information includes services at the rest area.
Find and compare the prices on flights, airline tickets and hotels deals to thousands of trip vacations with the biggest travel agencies.

GCC 2007 allows participants to track their progress on a virtual journey around the globe. The journey is measured by steps, which are tracked on pedometers. The solution manages 161 locations in a CMS to track and zoom between each one.
Search service for real estate or apartments to rent in Singapore.

An ongoing caption competition that selects two photos from a group on Flickr every day to receive dozens of funny captions. Also uses D3/node.js and Bing image search to show a collaborative mind map for brainstorming caption ideas.
View travel videos from around the world using Google Maps and YouTube.
Map-based price and fuel quality reporting community covering Brazil. Try searching for Rio de Janeiro

jiffr is a picture based dating service that works without words. You introduce yourself without words, only using the language of your flickr pictures and so you get a date without words. This is a free service.
PhoneTap lets you record your outgoing phone calls, giving you a record of who you talked to and what was said. Plays both parties a notice that the call is recorded at the start of each call.
Voxora is an easy way to share voice messages from places you visit. Check in on foursquare then call voxora and leave a message, call and listen to messages left by everyone else.
